explanation: Use recursive backtracking for literals, dot and starred tokens. Try every possible repetition count of a starred token before matching the remaining pattern. A leading caret restricts the starting position; a trailing dollar requires the text end.
timeComplexity: Exponential worst case; O((n+p)²·2^(n+p)) is a conservative bound including substring copying and unanchored starts
spaceComplexity: O((n+p)²) active substring and recursion storage
